# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probe inspects item embeddings and sequence-conditioned positive/negative scores. Model implementation is not supplied, so representation computation cannot be verified. `log2feats(sequence)` supplies position-wise features; `predict_score(features, items)` scores candidates at each position. The probe does not explicitly extract a final sequence representation or verify final-nonpadding readout and appended-mask inference.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` receives the compatibility view, although the constructor names it `model`. It accesses `item_emb`, `log2feats`, `predict_score`, `meta_data`, `review_data`, and `user_train`; the latter two are stored but unused. `view.model.itemnum` identifies real item IDs.

The loader yields `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with tensors shaped `B × L`. Sequences pass through `log2feats`; stacked positive/negative IDs have shape `B × L × 2`. Positions with positive ID zero are excluded. Margin evaluation uses evaluation mode and disables gradients.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding collapse:** Samples up to 2,048 real item embeddings using seed 42, excludes padding/reserved tokens, normalizes vectors, and averages off-diagonal cosine similarities. Mapping `(mean_cosine + 1)/2` produces the score. Higher indicates directional similarity; approximately 0.5 corresponds to zero average cosine, not necessarily collapse.
- **Positive/negative separation:** Across at most ten batches, computes `positive_logit − negative_logit`. Higher mean and tenth-percentile margins indicate stronger separation. Lower negative-win rates (`margin < 0`) and small-margin rates (`margin < 0.5`) are preferable.
- **Category breakdown:** Counts category memberships separately for positive and negative items in weak-margin and wrong-ranking cases, retaining the top 20 per group. These are raw counts, not normalized error rates.

# Perturbation & Tests

No sequence perturbation, shuffling, ablation, or sensitivity test runs. Random embedding sampling and supplied negative candidates are the only sampling components.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

`run_full_diagnosis` returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, covering collapse, four margin statistics, and category breakdowns. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` embeds these in instructions requesting a separate JSON interpretation with status, findings, implications, and evidence.

Category metadata is unavailable in this task, so breakdown lists should be empty. Metrics assess sampled training positions, not validation HR@10, full-catalog ranking, or generalization. Missing valid positions produce zero margin statistics, which can misleadingly resemble healthy error rates. Correct masked-target construction depends on the external loader/model contract.
